spec.description: CGNAT A10: pools publicos NAT-POOL-08/09/10/11 e rede interna 100.64.64.0/19. Lado src/dst e ifIndex sao brutos do NetFlow; sem inferencia de NAT, assinante ou ataque.

spec.title: IP publicos vistos na origem (nao presume NAT)

spec.rawSql: SELECT src_ip AS 'IP publico origem',protocol AS Protocolo,CASE WHEN input_if=0 THEN 'sem interface (0)' ELSE COALESCE(MAX(im_in.if_name),CONCAT('ifIndex ',input_if,' (sem nome)')) END AS 'Entrada Huawei',CASE WHEN output_if=0 THEN 'sem interface (0)' ELSE COALESCE(MAX(im_out.if_name),CONCAT('ifIndex ',output_if,' (sem nome)')) END AS 'Saída Huawei',CASE netflow_direction WHEN 0 THEN 'captura na entrada' WHEN 1 THEN 'captura na saída' ELSE 'direção não informada' END AS 'Captura',ROUND(SUM(total_bytes),0) AS 'Volume estimado' FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute LEFT JOIN orby_interface_names AS im_in ON im_in.source='huawei' AND im_in.if_index=input_if LEFT JOIN orby_interface_names AS im_out ON im_out.source='huawei' AND im_out.if_index=output_if WHERE orby_ip_pairs_minute.source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) AND (src_ip LIKE '45.238.170.%' OR src_ip LIKE '45.238.171.%' OR src_ip LIKE '187.87.201.%') GROUP BY src_ip,protocol,input_if,output_if,netflow_direction ORDER BY SUM(total_bytes) DESC LIMIT 30

spec.title: A10 CGNAT - Pool publico na ORIGEM (top protocolos/interfaces)

spec.rawSql: SELECT pool_name AS Pool, protocol AS Protocolo,CASE WHEN input_if=0 THEN 'sem interface (0)' ELSE COALESCE(MAX(im_in.if_name),CONCAT('ifIndex ',input_if,' (sem nome)')) END AS 'Entrada Huawei',CASE netflow_direction WHEN 0 THEN 'captura na entrada' WHEN 1 THEN 'captura na saída' ELSE 'direção não informada' END AS 'Captura', COUNT(DISTINCT ip_publico) AS 'IPs publicos observados',ROUND(SUM(total_bytes),0) AS 'Volume estimado' FROM (SELECT bucket_utc,protocol,input_if,output_if,netflow_direction,src_ip AS ip_publico,total_bytes,total_packets,CASE WHEN INET_ATON(src_ip) BETWEEN INET_ATON('45.238.170.64') AND INET_ATON('45.238.170.127') THEN 'NAT-POOL-08' WHEN INET_ATON(src_ip) BETWEEN INET_ATON('45.238.171.64') AND INET_ATON('45.238.171.127') THEN 'NAT-POOL-09' WHEN INET_ATON(src_ip) BETWEEN INET_ATON('45.238.170.128') AND INET_ATON('45.238.170.191') THEN 'NAT-POOL-10' WHEN INET_ATON(src_ip) BETWEEN INET_ATON('45.238.171.128') AND INET_ATON('45.238.171.191') THEN 'NAT-POOL-11' ELSE NULL END AS pool_name FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc)) a LEFT JOIN orby_interface_names AS im_in ON im_in.source='huawei' AND im_in.if_index=a.input_if WHERE pool_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY pool_name,protocol,input_if,netflow_direction ORDER BY SUM(total_bytes) DESC LIMIT 40

spec.title: A10 CGNAT - Pool publico no DESTINO (top protocolos/interfaces)

spec.rawSql: SELECT pool_name AS Pool,protocol AS Protocolo,CASE WHEN input_if=0 THEN 'sem interface (0)' ELSE COALESCE(MAX(im_in.if_name),CONCAT('ifIndex ',input_if,' (sem nome)')) END AS 'Entrada Huawei',CASE netflow_direction WHEN 0 THEN 'captura na entrada' WHEN 1 THEN 'captura na saída' ELSE 'direção não informada' END AS 'Captura',COUNT(DISTINCT ip_publico) AS 'IPs publicos observados',ROUND(SUM(total_bytes),0) AS 'Volume estimado' FROM (SELECT bucket_utc,protocol,input_if,output_if,netflow_direction,dst_ip AS ip_publico,total_bytes,total_packets,CASE WHEN INET_ATON(dst_ip) BETWEEN INET_ATON('45.238.170.64') AND INET_ATON('45.238.170.127') THEN 'NAT-POOL-08' WHEN INET_ATON(dst_ip) BETWEEN INET_ATON('45.238.171.64') AND INET_ATON('45.238.171.127') THEN 'NAT-POOL-09' WHEN INET_ATON(dst_ip) BETWEEN INET_ATON('45.238.170.128') AND INET_ATON('45.238.170.191') THEN 'NAT-POOL-10' WHEN INET_ATON(dst_ip) BETWEEN INET_ATON('45.238.171.128') AND INET_ATON('45.238.171.191') THEN 'NAT-POOL-11' ELSE NULL END AS pool_name FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc)) a LEFT JOIN orby_interface_names AS im_in ON im_in.source='huawei' AND im_in.if_index=a.input_if WHERE pool_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY pool_name,protocol,input_if,netflow_direction ORDER BY SUM(total_bytes) DESC LIMIT 40

spec.title: A10 - Taxa estimada por pool, interface e captura (IP na origem)

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(bucket_utc,'1m'),CONCAT(pool_name,' / ',CASE WHEN input_if=0 THEN 'sem interface (0)' ELSE COALESCE(im_in.if_name,CONCAT('ifIndex ',input_if,' (sem nome)')) END,' · ',CASE netflow_direction WHEN 0 THEN 'captura na entrada' WHEN 1 THEN 'captura na saída' ELSE 'direção não informada' END) AS metric,ROUND(SUM(total_bytes)*8/60,2) AS value FROM (SELECT bucket_utc,protocol,input_if,output_if,netflow_direction,src_ip AS ip_publico,total_bytes,total_packets,CASE WHEN INET_ATON(src_ip) BETWEEN INET_ATON('45.238.170.64') AND INET_ATON('45.238.170.127') THEN 'NAT-POOL-08' WHEN INET_ATON(src_ip) BETWEEN INET_ATON('45.238.171.64') AND INET_ATON('45.238.171.127') THEN 'NAT-POOL-09' WHEN INET_ATON(src_ip) BETWEEN INET_ATON('45.238.170.128') AND INET_ATON('45.238.170.191') THEN 'NAT-POOL-10' WHEN INET_ATON(src_ip) BETWEEN INET_ATON('45.238.171.128') AND INET_ATON('45.238.171.191') THEN 'NAT-POOL-11' ELSE NULL END AS pool_name FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc)) a LEFT JOIN orby_interface_names AS im_in ON im_in.source='huawei' AND im_in.if_index=a.input_if WHERE pool_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

spec.title: A10 - Rede interna 100.64.64.0/19 observada na ORIGEM (pre-NAT possivel)

spec.rawSql: SELECT src_ip AS 'IP interno observado',protocol AS Protocolo,CASE WHEN input_if=0 THEN 'sem interface (0)' ELSE COALESCE(MAX(im_in.if_name),CONCAT('ifIndex ',input_if,' (sem nome)')) END AS 'Entrada Huawei',CASE WHEN output_if=0 THEN 'sem interface (0)' ELSE COALESCE(MAX(im_out.if_name),CONCAT('ifIndex ',output_if,' (sem nome)')) END AS 'Saída Huawei',CASE netflow_direction WHEN 0 THEN 'captura na entrada' WHEN 1 THEN 'captura na saída' ELSE 'direção não informada' END AS 'Captura',ROUND(SUM(total_bytes),0) AS 'Volume estimado' FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute LEFT JOIN orby_interface_names AS im_in ON im_in.source='huawei' AND im_in.if_index=input_if LEFT JOIN orby_interface_names AS im_out ON im_out.source='huawei' AND im_out.if_index=output_if WHERE orby_ip_pairs_minute.source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) AND INET_ATON(src_ip) BETWEEN INET_ATON('100.64.64.0') AND INET_ATON('100.64.95.255') GROUP BY src_ip,protocol,input_if,output_if,netflow_direction ORDER BY SUM(total_bytes) DESC LIMIT 30

spec.title: A10 - Rede interna 100.64.64.0/19 observada no DESTINO (pre-NAT possivel)

spec.rawSql: SELECT dst_ip AS 'IP interno observado',protocol AS Protocolo,CASE WHEN input_if=0 THEN 'sem interface (0)' ELSE COALESCE(MAX(im_in.if_name),CONCAT('ifIndex ',input_if,' (sem nome)')) END AS 'Entrada Huawei',CASE WHEN output_if=0 THEN 'sem interface (0)' ELSE COALESCE(MAX(im_out.if_name),CONCAT('ifIndex ',output_if,' (sem nome)')) END AS 'Saída Huawei',CASE netflow_direction WHEN 0 THEN 'captura na entrada' WHEN 1 THEN 'captura na saída' ELSE 'direção não informada' END AS 'Captura',ROUND(SUM(total_bytes),0) AS 'Volume estimado' FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute LEFT JOIN orby_interface_names AS im_in ON im_in.source='huawei' AND im_in.if_index=input_if LEFT JOIN orby_interface_names AS im_out ON im_out.source='huawei' AND im_out.if_index=output_if WHERE orby_ip_pairs_minute.source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) AND INET_ATON(dst_ip) BETWEEN INET_ATON('100.64.64.0') AND INET_ATON('100.64.95.255') GROUP BY dst_ip,protocol,input_if,output_if,netflow_direction ORDER BY SUM(total_bytes) DESC LIMIT 30

spec.title: IP publicos vistos no destino (nao presume ataque)

spec.rawSql: SELECT dst_ip AS 'IP publico destino',protocol AS Protocolo,CASE WHEN input_if=0 THEN 'sem interface (0)' ELSE COALESCE(MAX(im_in.if_name),CONCAT('ifIndex ',input_if,' (sem nome)')) END AS 'Entrada Huawei',CASE WHEN output_if=0 THEN 'sem interface (0)' ELSE COALESCE(MAX(im_out.if_name),CONCAT('ifIndex ',output_if,' (sem nome)')) END AS 'Saída Huawei',CASE netflow_direction WHEN 0 THEN 'captura na entrada' WHEN 1 THEN 'captura na saída' ELSE 'direção não informada' END AS 'Captura',ROUND(SUM(total_bytes),0) AS 'Volume estimado' FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute LEFT JOIN orby_interface_names AS im_in ON im_in.source='huawei' AND im_in.if_index=input_if LEFT JOIN orby_interface_names AS im_out ON im_out.source='huawei' AND im_out.if_index=output_if WHERE orby_ip_pairs_minute.source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) AND (dst_ip LIKE '45.238.170.%' OR dst_ip LIKE '45.238.171.%' OR dst_ip LIKE '187.87.201.%') GROUP BY dst_ip,protocol,input_if,output_if,netflow_direction ORDER BY SUM(total_bytes) DESC LIMIT 30

spec.title: Atraso da última coleta Huawei (min; agora)
spec.description: Independente do período selecionado; negativo indica horário do fluxo no futuro. Ajuda a entender painéis vazios em 15/30 minutos.

spec.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,MAX(bucket_utc),UTC_TIMESTAMP())/60,1) AS value FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute WHERE source='huawei'

spec.title: Taxa estimada (IP local como origem) — 15 maiores picos

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(p.bucket_utc,'1m'),CONCAT(p.src_ip,' · entrou ',CASE WHEN p.input_if=0 THEN 'sem interface (0)' ELSE COALESCE(im.if_name,CONCAT('ifIndex ',p.input_if,' (sem nome)')) END,' · ',CASE p.netflow_direction WHEN 0 THEN 'captura na entrada' WHEN 1 THEN 'captura na saída' ELSE 'direção não informada' END) AS metric,ROUND(SUM(p.total_bytes)*8/60,2) AS value FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute AS p JOIN (SELECT ip FROM (SELECT src_ip AS ip,bucket_utc,SUM(total_bytes) AS b FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) AND (src_ip LIKE '45.238.170.%' OR src_ip LIKE '45.238.171.%' OR src_ip LIKE '187.87.201.%') GROUP BY src_ip,bucket_utc) x GROUP BY ip ORDER BY MAX(b) DESC LIMIT 15) AS top ON top.ip=p.src_ip LEFT JOIN orby_interface_names AS im ON im.source='huawei' AND im.if_index=p.input_if WHERE p.source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(p.bucket_utc) GROUP BY 1,p.src_ip,p.input_if,p.netflow_direction,im.if_name ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Taxa estimada (IP local como destino) — 15 maiores picos

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(p.bucket_utc,'1m'),CONCAT(p.dst_ip,' · entrou ',CASE WHEN p.input_if=0 THEN 'sem interface (0)' ELSE COALESCE(im.if_name,CONCAT('ifIndex ',p.input_if,' (sem nome)')) END,' · ',CASE p.netflow_direction WHEN 0 THEN 'captura na entrada' WHEN 1 THEN 'captura na saída' ELSE 'direção não informada' END) AS metric,ROUND(SUM(p.total_bytes)*8/60,2) AS value FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute AS p JOIN (SELECT ip FROM (SELECT dst_ip AS ip,bucket_utc,SUM(total_bytes) AS b FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) AND (dst_ip LIKE '45.238.170.%' OR dst_ip LIKE '45.238.171.%' OR dst_ip LIKE '187.87.201.%') GROUP BY dst_ip,bucket_utc) x GROUP BY ip ORDER BY MAX(b) DESC LIMIT 15) AS top ON top.ip=p.dst_ip LEFT JOIN orby_interface_names AS im ON im.source='huawei' AND im.if_index=p.input_if WHERE p.source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(p.bucket_utc) GROUP BY 1,p.dst_ip,p.input_if,p.netflow_direction,im.if_name ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Origens remotas distintas para IPs publicos de destino

spec.rawSql: SELECT dst_ip AS 'IP publico destino',protocol AS Protocolo,CASE WHEN input_if=0 THEN 'sem interface (0)' ELSE COALESCE(MAX(im_in.if_name),CONCAT('ifIndex ',input_if,' (sem nome)')) END AS 'Entrada Huawei',COUNT(DISTINCT src_ip) AS 'IPs remotos observados',ROUND(SUM(total_bytes),0) AS 'Volume estimado' FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute LEFT JOIN orby_interface_names AS im_in ON im_in.source='huawei' AND im_in.if_index=input_if LEFT JOIN orby_interface_names AS im_out ON im_out.source='huawei' AND im_out.if_index=output_if WHERE orby_ip_pairs_minute.source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) AND (dst_ip LIKE '45.238.170.%' OR dst_ip LIKE '45.238.171.%' OR dst_ip LIKE '187.87.201.%') GROUP BY dst_ip,protocol,input_if ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT src_ip) DESC LIMIT 25

spec.title: Destinos remotos distintos de IPs publicos de origem

spec.rawSql: SELECT src_ip AS 'IP publico origem',protocol AS Protocolo,CASE WHEN input_if=0 THEN 'sem interface (0)' ELSE COALESCE(MAX(im_in.if_name),CONCAT('ifIndex ',input_if,' (sem nome)')) END AS 'Entrada Huawei',COUNT(DISTINCT dst_ip) AS 'IPs remotos observados',ROUND(SUM(total_bytes),0) AS 'Volume estimado' FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute LEFT JOIN orby_interface_names AS im_in ON im_in.source='huawei' AND im_in.if_index=input_if LEFT JOIN orby_interface_names AS im_out ON im_out.source='huawei' AND im_out.if_index=output_if WHERE orby_ip_pairs_minute.source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) AND (src_ip LIKE '45.238.170.%' OR src_ip LIKE '45.238.171.%' OR src_ip LIKE '187.87.201.%') GROUP BY src_ip,protocol,input_if ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT dst_ip) DESC LIMIT 25

spec.title: IPs do provedor observados na origem

spec.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT src_ip) AS value FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) AND (src_ip LIKE '45.238.170.%' OR src_ip LIKE '45.238.171.%' OR src_ip LIKE '187.87.201.%')

spec.title: Interfaces mais envolvidas com nossos blocos

spec.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN input_if=0 THEN 'sem interface (0)' ELSE COALESCE(MAX(im_in.if_name),CONCAT('ifIndex ',input_if,' (sem nome)')) END AS 'Entrada Huawei',CASE WHEN output_if=0 THEN 'sem interface (0)' ELSE COALESCE(MAX(im_out.if_name),CONCAT('ifIndex ',output_if,' (sem nome)')) END AS 'Saída Huawei',CASE netflow_direction WHEN 0 THEN 'captura na entrada' WHEN 1 THEN 'captura na saída' ELSE 'direção não informada' END AS 'Captura',ROUND(SUM(total_bytes),0) AS 'Volume estimado' FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute LEFT JOIN orby_interface_names AS im_in ON im_in.source='huawei' AND im_in.if_index=input_if LEFT JOIN orby_interface_names AS im_out ON im_out.source='huawei' AND im_out.if_index=output_if WHERE orby_ip_pairs_minute.source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) AND ((src_ip LIKE '45.238.170.%' OR src_ip LIKE '45.238.171.%' OR src_ip LIKE '187.87.201.%') OR (dst_ip LIKE '45.238.170.%' OR dst_ip LIKE '45.238.171.%' OR dst_ip LIKE '187.87.201.%')) GROUP BY input_if,output_if,netflow_direction ORDER BY SUM(total_bytes) DESC LIMIT 30
